ai-agent: Illustration: a horizontal storyboard-style diagram showing a single AI agent icon (a small robotic node) at the left, connected by a continuous arrow that loops through a sequence of five action bubbles labeled "check information," "decide," "place order," "send message," and "act again" — each bubble flowing directly into the next with no human figure or checkpoint icon interrupting the chain. humanoid-robot: A cutaway illustration of a humanoid robot standing in an everyday setting — one side of its body rendered as a realistic android with a torso, head, arms, and legs matched to human proportions, the other side exposed to reveal its mechanical joints, camera "eyes," a microphone icon near its head, and a chest-mounted processor unit labeled with a small cloud symbol to suggest AI connectivity; the robot reaches with a gripper hand toward a shelf item at normal human reach-height in a space with unmodified doors, counters, and shelving, subtly emphasizing that its human-like shape lets it use the same surroundings people do, while a faint thought-bubble or screen display above its head shows it confidently recognizing a single known object but rendered with a question mark or glitch icon when facing a jumbled, unexpected pile of objects beside it — visually contrasting its competence at repetitive, well-defined tasks with its struggle to improvise.
